definitions.explanation: Bonds issued by national or local governments to finance public spending. Also refers to the resulting public debt.

examples.japanese: {公債|こうさい}を{発行|はっこう}する。
{公債|こうさい}{残高|ざんだか}が{年々|ねんねん}{増加|ぞうか}している。
examples.english: The outstanding public debt has been increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{財政|ざいせい}{赤字|あかじ}を{補|おぎな}うために{大量|たいりょう}の{公債|こうさい}を{発行|はっこう}せざるを{得|え}なかった。
examples.english: The government had no choice but to issue a large volume of bonds to cover the fiscal deficit.

notes:
A compound of {公|こう} (public) and {債|さい} (debt, bond). Covers both national government bonds ({国債|こくさい}) and local government bonds ({地方債|ちほうさい}).

Japan has one of the highest public debt-to-GDP ratios in the world, making {公債|こうさい} a frequently discussed topic in Japanese news and politics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公債|こうさい}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue government bonds
- {公債|こうさい}{残高|ざんだか}: outstanding government debt
- {公債|こうさい}{費|ひ}: debt service costs
- {公債|こうさい}{依存|いぞん}{度|ど}: bond dependency ratio

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国債|こくさい}: national government bond — specifically bonds issued by the central government
- {社債|しゃさい}: corporate bond — bonds issued by private companies
- {地方債|ちほうさい}: municipal bond — bonds issued by local governments
